name: CRM prospect conversion marger function flow script
script:
master_item = frappe.form_dict.get("master_item")

duplicate_items = frappe.form_dict.get("duplicate_items")


# ------------------------------------------------
# Validate Input
# ------------------------------------------------

if not master_item:
    frappe.throw("Master Item is required.")


if not duplicate_items:
    frappe.throw("Prospect Items are required.")


# ------------------------------------------------
# Convert duplicate_items into list
# ------------------------------------------------

if isinstance(duplicate_items, str):

    try:
        duplicate_items = frappe.parse_json(duplicate_items)

    except Exception:

        duplicate_items = (
            duplicate_items
            .strip("[]")
            .replace('"', '')
            .split(",")
        )


duplicate_items = [
    item.strip()
    for item in duplicate_items
    if item and item.strip()
]


# ------------------------------------------------
# Get Master
# ------------------------------------------------

master_doc = frappe.get_doc(
    "CRM Prospect Item Conversion Status",
    master_item
)


# ------------------------------------------------
# Master must be Active
# ------------------------------------------------

if master_doc.status != "Active":

    frappe.throw(
        "Master item must have Status = Active."
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# Master can be Prospect Item OR Existing Item
# ------------------------------------------------

if master_doc.product_type not in [
    "Prospect Item",
    "Existing Item"
]:

    frappe.throw(
        "Master item must have Product Type = Prospect Item or Existing Item."
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# Identify Master Type
# ------------------------------------------------

master_is_existing = (
    master_doc.product_type == "Existing Item"
)


# ------------------------------------------------
# Update Prospect Items
# ------------------------------------------------

updated_items = []


for item_name in duplicate_items:

    # --------------------------------------------
    # Do not process Master itself
    # --------------------------------------------

    if item_name == master_item:
        continue


    # --------------------------------------------
    # Get Prospect Item
    # --------------------------------------------

    duplicate_doc = frappe.get_doc(
        "CRM Prospect Item Conversion Status",
        item_name
    )


    # --------------------------------------------
    # Only Prospect Items can be converted
    # --------------------------------------------

    if duplicate_doc.product_type != "Prospect Item":

        frappe.throw(
            "Only Prospect Items can be converted. Invalid item: "
            + item_name
        )


    # --------------------------------------------
    # Only Active Prospect Items
    # --------------------------------------------

    if duplicate_doc.status != "Active":

        frappe.throw(
            "Only Active Prospect Items can be converted. Invalid item: "
            + item_name
        )


    # --------------------------------------------
    # Mark as Converted
    # --------------------------------------------

    duplicate_doc.status = "Converted"


    # --------------------------------------------
    # Store Master / Merge Information
    # --------------------------------------------

    duplicate_doc.merged_into = master_item


    # --------------------------------------------
    # If Master is Existing Item
    # store Existing Item information
    # --------------------------------------------

    if master_is_existing:

        duplicate_doc.erp_next_item_name = (
            master_doc.product_name
        )


    # --------------------------------------------
    # Conversion Information
    # --------------------------------------------

    duplicate_doc.converted_on = frappe.utils.now()

    duplicate_doc.converted_by = frappe.session.user


    # --------------------------------------------
    # Save Prospect Item
    # --------------------------------------------

    duplicate_doc.save(
        ignore_permissions=True
    )


    updated_items.append(item_name)


# ------------------------------------------------
# Existing Item Master
# ------------------------------------------------
#
# IMPORTANT:
# Existing Item is NOT modified.
#
# It remains:
#
# Status = Active
# Product Type = Existing Item
#
# ------------------------------------------------


if master_is_existing:

    # Do NOT save/update Existing Item.
    pass


# ------------------------------------------------
# Prospect Item Master
# ------------------------------------------------

else:

    # Keep selected Prospect Item Active

    master_doc.status = "Active"

    master_doc.merged_into = ""

    master_doc.save(
        ignore_permissions=True
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# Commit
# ------------------------------------------------

frappe.db.commit()


# ------------------------------------------------
# Response
# ------------------------------------------------

if master_is_existing:

    response_message = (
        "Existing Item remains unchanged. "
        + str(len(updated_items))
        + " Prospect Items marked as Converted and linked to the Existing Item."
    )

else:

    response_message = (
        "Master Prospect Item remains Active. "
        + str(len(updated_items))
        + " duplicate Prospect Items marked as Converted."
    )


frappe.response["message"] = {

    "success": True,

    "master_item": master_item,

    "master_product_name": master_doc.product_name,

    "master_product_type": master_doc.product_type,

    "converted_items": updated_items,

    "message": response_message

}

name: Create Prospect Item Status from CRM Product
script:
# Automatically create CRM Prospect Item Conversion Status
# when a CRM Product is created.

# Check if conversion-status record already exists
existing = frappe.db.exists(
    "CRM Prospect Item Conversion Status",
    {
        "erp_next_item_name": doc.name
    }
)

if not existing:

    conversion = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "CRM Prospect Item Conversion Status",

        # CRM Product name
        "product_name": doc.name,

        # Existing item because it came from CRM Product
        "product_type": "Existing Item",

        # Link back to CRM Product
        "erp_next_item_name": doc.name,

        # New CRM Product is active
        "status": "Active",

        # Prospect Item Name intentionally blank
        "prospect_item_name": None
    })

    conversion.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
